plugin.name: Custom My Account Page for WooCommerce
plugin.description: Turns the WooCommerce My Account page into a branded customer portal: reorder/rename/disable default endpoints, add custom endpoints, collapsible groups and external links, restrict items by user role, upload a per-member avatar, and override menu colours. Admin runs on the shared Wbcom settings shell; no REST, no custom tables.

ajax.purpose: Endpoint builder: render the row for a new endpoint / group / link. Target allowlist [endpoint, group, link]; typed name is the label, key is an ASCII slug from create_field_key() (intl transliteration, else {type}-N); rejects slugs already in the builder or in WooCommerce query vars.
Return the avatar upload/reset form markup for the change-photo popup on My Account.

form_post_handlers.purpose: Handle the member avatar upload (media_handle_upload), validate MIME [jpeg/png/gif/webp] + 2MB cap, delete the previous avatar (attachment + square copies + registry), store attachment id in user meta wb-wcmp-avatar, then redirect.
Delete the custom avatar via wcmp_delete_user_avatar() (attachment, square copies, registry, user meta) and fall back to Gravatar.

data_lifecycle.uninstall: uninstall.php deletes every avatar attachment in wcmp-users-avatar-ids, all wb-wcmp-avatar user meta, wcmp_general_settings, wcmp_endpoints_settings, wcmp_style_settings, wcmp_endpoint_order, wcmp_is_my_account, wcmp-users-avatar-ids, legacy wcmp_endpoint, every wcmp_endpoint_backup_pre_* backup and the three license options, then flushes rewrite rules.

security.avatar_upload: Avatar setting must be on. MIME allowlist [image/jpeg,png,gif,webp] via wp_check_filetype_and_ext, 2MB cap, logged-in gate, wp_handle_upload nonce, media_handle_upload; the previous avatar is deleted so each user keeps one attachment. PRG redirect. 1.7.1: limits live in Woo_Custom_My_Account_Page_Public::AVATAR_MAX_BYTES / AVATAR_TYPES, used by the upload handler and printed into the avatar form (data-max-bytes, data-types, accept) for a browser-side pre-check; the server check stays authoritative. The AJAX form output passes through wp_kses with get_form_allowed_html(); new template attributes must be added there.
security.ajax_gate: wcmp_add_field_ajax: nonce wcmp_add_field + manage_options + target allowlist. wcmp_print_avatar_form_ajax: wp_doing_ajax + is_user_logged_in + avatar setting on.
security.endpoint_content: kses_post for non-unfiltered_html users, raw for unfiltered_html — same trust model as post_content. 1.7.1: a custom endpoint with no content and no woocommerce_account_{key}_endpoint handler prints a wc_print_notice() empty state (admin link gated on manage_options) instead of WooCommerce's dashboard fallback.
security.role_visibility: Visible to roles is an allowlist enforced on the request by wcmp_restrict_endpoint_access (template_redirect 20), not only in the menu; Hide from menu is menu-only. One rule for the guard and the default-endpoint redirect: wcmp_flatten_endpoints() lifts group children to the top level and wcmp_roles_can_view() applies the item list plus its group list.
security.settings_sanitize: wcmp_endpoints_settings_callback: keys sanitize_key, type allowlist [endpoint, group, link], slugs via create_field_key, slug uniqueness against other endpoints and WooCommerce query vars (add_settings_error on conflict), endpoints-order JSON rebuilt from sanitized id/type/children. wcmp_general_settings_callback (1.7.1): menu_style allowlist [sidebar, tab] and sidebar_position allowlist [left, right], unknown values fall back to default_general_settings(); default_endpoint is validated on read in wcmp_settings_data(). wcmp_settings_data() (1.7.1) prunes endpoints-order entries whose item no longer exists (wcmp_prune_endpoint_order) and returns the pruned order, so the next admin save stores it.
security.notes: No custom tables, no REST surface — attack surface is the two AJAX actions, two avatar POST flows, and the Settings API screens.

known_contract_baseline: See .contract-audit-baseline.json: eight suppressions (wcmp_endpoint_order / wcmp_is_my_account written-never-read; wcmp_endpoint dual-key; wcmp_settings_nav_groups / wcmp_settings_tab_content consumed-never-fired — these are fired by the bundled Wbcom_Settings_Page shell, not this plugin's own code, so the static audit cannot see the producer; ajax-action-no-handler:wcmp_reset_avatar — actually a template_redirect POST form, not admin-ajax; ajax-handler-unreferenced:wcmp_add_field — referenced via JS localize action_add; dom-action-no-handler:delete). All carry TODO 'justify or fix' reasons and should be resolved before the next release.
